name: item
title: Item
description: Rows in lists of files, members, and invoices.

motionProfile.reason: Item coordinates one row's presence, content-driven block size, changed display text and scoped surface paint; ItemGroup places retained rows from committed boxes while composed controls keep their own owners.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Item integrates its row entrance, the media and action regions and the current supplied media visual; composed controls and rich child content retain their native owners.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Item integrates its row exit and the media/action region exit on the same retained hosts; no outgoing interactive copy is created.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: Item owns its content/header/footer-driven block height after commitment; ItemGroup writes no row geometry and the rule follows layout.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Item replaces changed runs in the plain title, description, content, header and footer displays; composed rich content keeps its own owner.

number.roll/reels.reason: Item reels direct display quantities in the same known plain parts; identifiers and composed metrics remain textual or composed.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Item owns the row and media surface-foreground paint plus explicit title and description foreground; ItemSeparator delegates its rule colour.
